summary: Resuming imp-2 (Lane A gate session) for the full judge run returned an empty task_result and produced no work: no new watchdog spend (lane A still $0.0054), no new files in eval/ab_plan/modal_judge/, no cokro-judge apps, no lane-a-full-judge trace.
root_cause: Flaky resume behavior on the task tool: imp-5 first dispatch returned an empty task_result but DID the work; imp-2 resume returned an empty task_result and did NO work. Likely a session-state issue when resuming a large completed session.
what_i_did_wrong: Trusted the resume path after the known open compaction NCR (NCR-2026-09-28-SUBAGENT-COMPACTION-001) without immediately verifying evidence; lost a round-trip. Should have verified spend/files right after the resume returned empty.
remediation: Verified evidence on the next step (no work done), then dispatched a fresh implementer session with a complete self-contained spec; the full judge run completed successfully (23,282/23,284 valid judgments, metrics computed).
lesson: After any empty task_result, verify against reality (spend/files/apps/trace) before reconciling; prefer fresh sessions with self-contained specs over resuming large sessions for new work.
